source_claim: Push 2 sample workflow uses Simpler: empty state prompts sample browsing, loaded waveform/position/zoom controls and Classic/One-Shot/Slicing choices are exposed. Simpler Edit pages, crop/reverse and slice creation/nudge/split/delete are controller entrypoints only; all mode/voice/DSP/sample semantics remain with sample-instrument and conversion/media owners.
documentary_expected: Push 2 sample workflow uses Simpler: empty state prompts sample browsing, loaded waveform/position/zoom controls and Classic/One-Shot/Slicing choices are exposed. Simpler Edit pages, crop/reverse and slice creation/nudge/split/delete are controller entrypoints only; all mode/voice/DSP/sample semantics remain with sample-instrument and conversion/media owners.
documentary_comparator: Compare only text-supported named controls, modes, display/selection or membership predicates; no pad-number, signal, timing, LED-palette, protocol or hardware parity oracle.

title: Clip mode controls and display
setup_and_action: F-EDIT/F-SAMPLE: known audio and MIDI clips plus no-selection case, positive sources and explicit loop/layout; inspect Clip controls, offered Crop/range/zoom and sequenceable area. All timing, detune conversion, loop and sample outputs null.
source_claim: Clip opens selected-clip parameters with audio/no-selection prompt, loop/start/end controls, zoom and audio Warp/gain/transpose context. MIDI layouts have Crop and sequenceable-area display/range navigation. Clip View and MIDI owners retain region/edit algorithms; no pad/time or folded-view numeric law is added.

title: Touch strip and User Mode roles
setup_and_action: F-PITCH/F-DRUM: positive active eligible instrument expression target then rack/sequencer, admitted nonzero target/base and output; compare actual strip/User modes via existing mapping owner only. Signal/protocol outcomes remain null.
source_claim: Instrument real-time touch strip selects pitch bend/mod wheel with Select-tap; melodic sequencing changes range and Drum Rack changes bank. User Mode disables built-in roles for alternate mapping; recommended relative mode is not exact configuration-token/codec equivalence.

title: Hardware
setup_and_action: Independently accepted matching model/firmware/host/USB/input/output and positive pad/encoder/display response first. Retain actual events and feedback while changing one offered mode; no device is acquired or simulated, no packet/LED/touch codec or latency oracle.

title: Inactive
setup_and_action: Start from independently active eligible instrument/pad/section and nonzero source/base/amount/gain with nonmuted output; compare another actually offered ineligible mode/track or disabled path against matched positive trial. Silence/absent controller cannot prove no-effect.

title: Selected slot
setup_and_action: Compare populated selected/unselected and independently empty selected slots with arm/monitor/record/transport/Workflow declared. Inspect launch/record availability and effects without deriving empty-slot recording law from the broad selected-track sentence.

title: Boundaries
setup_and_action: On disposable copies compare valid interior step/page/sample/range with first/last/empty/occupied destination, equal/reversed numeric text and multi-selection. Use offered controls only; no clamp/refusal/pad-index/merge rule.

title: Malformed
setup_and_action: After valid positive edit, attempt abc/NaN/out-of-range text through actually offered Live companion control or independently understood saved-state owner. Hardware encoders have no invented text parser or hidden command; missing admission remains U.

title: Undo
setup_and_action: Retain complete note/clip/device/route before-inventory, then separately edit step, duplicate pad/page, load device and record automation. Invoke offered Undo/Redo; generic entrypoints do not guarantee transaction grouping or restored physical state.

title: Cancel
setup_and_action: Begin offered browse/load, held layout/parameter gesture or length selection, then dismiss/release using available controls before and after actual commit in separate copies. No universal cancellation or rollback is assumed.

title: Reopen
setup_and_action: Save/reopen disposable Set after scale/Workflow/layout/pad response/automation edits separately, keeping required source/controller then removing it in a copy. Record Set/global/controller state without broad persistence or firmware-default assumptions.

title: Record and automation
setup_and_action: Independent nonzero source, eligible armed/monitored target, explicit running transport and appropriate record/Automation Arm plus active nonzero envelope/base/depth first. Compare per-step versus live pass, manual override/re-enable and recorded playback without event/timebase or return comparator.

title: Transport rate
setup_and_action: After positive playback/record baseline compare stop/start/seek/loop/tempo/meter changes, then separately actually supported 44.1/48/96 kHz and 64/512-frame settings or engine restart. No repeat/latency/velocity/signal invariance or phase deadline.

title: Disconnect
setup_and_action: After independently working source/target and accepted hardware input/output baseline, remove only available controller/port/media/device in separate copies during held pad/encoder or recording; reconnect through offered controls. No stuck-note prevention, silence or reconstruction oracle.

title: Teardown
setup_and_action: During positive held note, recording, step edit or pending browse operation separately close/replace Set, remove track or quit using offered controls. Retain prompts/physical and software state if available; no completion/cleanup/flush guarantee.
